title: Samurai Troopers Memorials Deluxe
originalTitle: サムライトルーパー・メモリアルズ　デラックス
summary: A deluxe illustration collection for Gaiden through Legend of the Inferno Armor, also reproducing TV-era CD, VHS, and goods artwork. It includes new art by Manami Hattori and Miki Ukai, plus a VHS tape and poster; the tape contains character scene compilations and a few seconds of new Yamada-supervised footage.
